attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **She is the eighth woman of a company of which the corpus already keeps seven**, so she is the only new folder out of that page: Thecusa, Alexandra, Claudia, Phaina, Euphrasia, Matrona and Julia of Ancyra all exist and are upgraded in `up-05-18.json`, and no folder carries a Theodote of Ancyra — the corpus's three Theodotes are of Nicaea, the mother of the Unmercenaries, and the daughter of Athanasia. **She is not the day's Theodotus**, the nephew of Thecusa who buried them, whom the corpus keeps as `theodotus-of-ancyra`; the Greek names both on the same page and this folder links him. **The page disagrees with itself about how many women there were, and that is recorded rather than resolved**: eight are named as head entries and in the calendar line, and the verse over the narrative is headed «Εις τας επτά», for the seven, «Λίμνη γυναικών επτάς εμβεβλημένη» — a sevenfold company of women cast into a lake. Nothing on the page reconciles the two counts, and nothing here does either. **No year, so no `dates` object**: the page gives none for the women, although the Theodotus head line on the same page reads «(; - 304)». **No `locations` object**, although Ancyra in Galatia is named. **The governor Theoteknos has no folder.** No hymn stands on this page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
